testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, form inputs, cards, dropdowns must have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-services', data-testid='contact-form-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page React router application for TSOR Technologies matching all sitemap items.
Implement the 5 top-level routes: Home, Who We Are, What We Do, Industries, Contact.
Ensure 'What We Do' detailed showcase covers all 10 sub-services, R&D, and Coming Soon badges for Products and Training.
Ensure 'Industries' page showcases all 9 specified industries with custom visual identity and metrics.
Ensure 'Who We Are' contains the requested simple Careers / Join Us info section with culture highlights and application form modal/drawer.
Use Lenis for smooth scroll, framer-motion for scrollytelling masked animations, and lucide-react icons.
Ensure all components follow the dark architectural slate theme, high contrast ratios, and complete data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic Inter font for headings; use Syne or Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do NOT use pure #000000 background; use #0B0F17 or #111827 tinted dark slate.
Always set explicit hover text colors and data-testid on interactive elements.
Do NOT use placeholder image services like placehold.it; use provided real image URLs.
